goal: The model recorded for a task (report, ledger, events) is the model that actually answered the final turn.
why: Measurement and re-optimization rely on it; today the first rung is recorded after a climb (POLL-RUNTIME).
acceptance: after a climb from rung A to B the report, ledger and events all name B
a regression test fails if the recorded model differs from the answering one
constraints: spec only: Dev/Ops decide method and plan
